title: AgenticCity-Bench: Longitudinal Multimodal Observations of Urban Dynamics with Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: City systems are shaped by interactions among infrastructure, human activity, and environmental conditions. Existing earth observation and urban benchmarks are limited in unified modeling and in capturing their joint dynamics. We introduce AgenticCity-Bench, a longitudinal multimodal benchmark for multi-layer unified state modeling and agentic city task reasoning. The benchmark covers 16 cities in 12 countries across six continents from 2000 to 2025, and includes 18 modalities spanning urban function, activity, and environmental state. It organizes heterogeneous data sources around a common spatial reference and calendar index while preserving spatial and temporal coverage, provenance and tile-level availability. On this foundation, AgenticCity-Bench supports urban cross-modal translation together with diverse agentic city tasks involving forecasting, planning and resource analysis. translated_title: AgenticCity-Bench：基于智能体推理的城市动态纵向多模态观测
translated_abstract: 城市系统由基础设施、人类活动和环境条件之间的相互作用所塑造。现有的地球观测与城市基准在统一建模以及捕捉其联合动态方面存在局限。我们提出了AgenticCity-Bench，一个面向多层统一状态建模与智能体城市任务推理的纵向多模态基准。该基准覆盖六大洲12个国家的16个城市，时间跨度从2000年至2025年，包含涵盖城市功能、人类活动和环境状态的18种模态。它以统一的空间参考和日历索引来组织异构数据源，同时保留了时空覆盖范围、数据来源以及瓦片级的可用性。在此基础上，AgenticCity-Bench支持城市跨模态转换，以及涉及预测、规划和资源分析等多种智能体城市任务。本研究为研究城市系统提供了统一的基准（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: AgenticCity-Bench是一个覆盖2000–2025年六大洲16个城市、包含18种模态的纵向多模态城市基准，通过统一的空间与时间索引实现多层统一状态建模，并支持预测、规划和资源分析等智能体城市任务推理。
en_tdlr: AgenticCity-Bench is a longitudinal multimodal benchmark spanning 16 cities across six continents (2000–2025) with 18 modalities, enabling unified multi-layer state modeling and agentic city task reasoning such as forecasting, planning, and resource analysis.
